questions.question: Every member of the Four Horsemen
questions.subject: Four Horsemen
questions.note: Precision probe: the wiki's Four Horsemen page lists exactly four members -- Control, War, Famine and Death. The Control Devil spans both parts: Makima (Part 1, killed in the Control Devil arc) and her reincarnation Nayuta (Part 2). The Death Devil initially posed as Famine under the alias Fami, but the Famine Devil is a separate sister.

questions.question: Every Weapon Devil
questions.subject: Weapon Devils
questions.note: The wiki's Weapon Devils page records exactly seven members, each later fused with a human to become a Hybrid (see csm-set-06). The Chainsaw Devil is deliberately NOT among them -- a common false positive, hence `absent`.

questions.question: Every Hybrid
questions.subject: Hybrid
questions.note: The wiki's Hybrid page states there are currently eight known Hybrids and lists them all; four of them (Flamethrower, Longsword, Spear, Whip) call themselves the Weapons in the Chainsaw Man Church arc. Includes the Chainsaw Hybrid, which csm-set-05 deliberately excludes.

questions.question: Every Primal Fear Devil
questions.subject: Devil
questions.note: Drawn from the wiki's Primal Devils group, which names exactly Darkness, Falling, Aging and Death. The Death Devil is both a Primal Fear and a Horseman, so it deliberately overlaps csm-set-04. The dragon-like Devil in the Justice Devil arc is never confirmed as a Primal Fear and is excluded.

questions.question: Every named member of Tokyo Special Division 4
questions.subject: Tokyo Special Division 4
questions.note: The wiki's Members section lists these fourteen named members with their fates; the unit went defunct after Makima's death in the Control Devil arc. The two generic unnamed pages are excluded and listed in `absent`. Part 1, Public Safety Saga.

questions.question: Who killed Makima?
questions.subject: Makima
questions.note: Part 1, Control Devil arc. Cross-entity relation: the wiki records that Denji killed Makima by cooking and eating her -- her dying request, which bypassed her contract with the Prime Minister. Makima is the Control Devil and reincarnated as Nayuta in Part 2.

questions.question: Who is the host of the War Devil?
questions.subject: Asa Mitaka
questions.note: Part 2, Academy Saga. Cross-entity relation: after dying, Asa Mitaka accepted the War Devil Yoru's offer to share her body; the wiki names her as the host of the War Devil and the War Fiend. Scoped to the Academy Saga, since the series' final chapters separate them again.

questions.question: Who is the Chainsaw Devil?
questions.subject: Pochita
questions.note: Part 1, Intro arc. Precision: the Chainsaw Devil is Pochita himself -- the original Chainsaw Man -- not Denji, who is the human fused with him as his heart.

questions.question: Who is the Gun Fiend?
questions.subject: Aki Hayakawa
questions.note: Part 1, Gun Devil arc. Cross-entity relation: Aki was killed and possessed by 20% of the Gun Devil, becoming the host of the Gun Fiend; the wiki lists Gun Fiend as one of his aliases and the Fiend nav points to him.

questions.question: Every ability of Denji
questions.subject: Denji
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `core` because the page's Abilities section is sprawling -- Physical Prowess, Hybrid Powers and Skillset name seventeen abilities, with a Devil Contracts subsection and a Weapons subsection adding more, so a closed enumeration would drown the precision measurement. Records the named abilities proper; the Devil Contracts subsection (pacts with Pochita, Power and the Aging Devil) and the Weapons subsection (hatchet, Blood Chainsaw, Super Chainsaw Man Motorcycle, Bitterness Axe) are excluded as relationships and equipment rather than abilities. Spans both parts: the page documents him across the Public Safety Saga (Part 1) and the Academy Saga (Part 2), and no ability contradicts between them -- Part 2 adds Chain Grappling and the Aging Devil contract without revising any Part 1 ability. Differs from csm-set-01, which asks for his three forms (Human, Chainsaw Man, Chainsaw Devil).

questions.question: Every documented ability of Power
questions.subject: Power
questions.note: Renamed twice on 2026-08-14. The bare `Every ability of Power` collided word for word with csm-set-02, and the report picks its comparable-with-2026-08-04 subset by question text while diagnose_misses resolves an item's canon list the same way, so the duplicate corrupted both. The first replacement appended a parenthetical and cost the question 15/16 -- subject resolution dropped to `Character Subpage` and returned nothing canon -- so the wording is now a plain adjective. The report selects its comparable-with-2026-08-04 subset by question text and diagnose_misses resolves an item's canon list the same way, so two questions sharing a string corrupted both. Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `core` because the page documents a large list -- sixteen named abilities across Physical Abilities, Devil Powers, Skillset and Other Abilities -- so a closed enumeration would drown the precision measurement. Broader than csm-set-02 (Every ability of Power, scored 0 to 4/6 on 2026-08-04), which recorded six core blood abilities; this question records the complete set the page documents, including Blood Knife, Blood Scythe, Blood Dagger, Blood Axe, Blood Transfer, Blood Empowerment and the skill entries. Blood Weaponization from csm-set-02 is not repeated here because the page does not name it. Spans both parts: the page records her Part 1 feats and her return in the Academy Saga War Devil arc, where the revived Blood Devil uses Blood Dagger, Blood Axe and Blood Chainsaw -- consistent, no contradiction. The existing set is deliberately left untouched (append-only).

questions.question: Every ability of Aki Hayakawa
questions.subject: Aki Hayakawa
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the page's Abilities section is a bounded named list. Part 1, Public Safety Saga: Aki dies in the Gun Devil arc and his Part 2 appearances are flashbacks, so nothing is drawn from the Academy Saga. Differs from csm-set-03 (Every devil contract of Aki Hayakawa): that question enumerates the pacts themselves (Fox, Curse, Future), whereas this records the named powers and skills his page documents, including the powers the contracts granted (Precognition, Summoning) but not the contracts. Postmortem abilities (Enhanced Durability, Enhanced Speed, Bullet Projection, Blood Consumption) are included because the page documents them on Aki's own page under Postmortem Abilities; they belong to his Gun Fiend state, which csm-fact-04 identifies. Cooking and Driving are named in his Skillset and are recorded as documented.

questions.question: Every ability of Makima
questions.subject: Makima
questions.note: Added 2026-08-14, per-character abilities batch. `closed` -- the page's Abilities section is a bounded named list of eight entries. Part 1, Control Devil arc: Makima dies in the Control Devil arc and reincarnates as Nayuta in Part 2, so nothing recorded here carries into the Academy Saga. Control and Force Manipulation are the page's two supernatural ability headings; the Prime Minister Contract (the fatal-damage transfer pact) is recorded even though it appears in the section's prose rather than as a bolded heading, because it is her defining defensive ability. `Shihai` is the romanised Nihongo name recorded for Control.
